journey.name: Platform Payment Alert Recipients
journey.description: Validates that administrators can view and configure the platform payment alert email recipients who receive notifications when ShopSynch's gateway credentials become invalid or healthy again, with email validation and empty state messaging.

story.title: Configure platform credential health alert recipients

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/payment-gateways'.
Verify the alert card explains that notifications are sent when platform credentials fail or circuits open, and indicates if no recipients are currently configured.
Enter an invalid email format (e.g. 'not-an-email') and click 'Save Alert Recipients'.
Verify validation errors are displayed beside the input field and no API request is sent.
Enter valid comma-separated emails (e.g. 'ops@shopsynch.com, oncall@shopsynch.com') and click 'Save Alert Recipients'.
Verify a success toast confirms that alert recipients have been updated.
Navigate to '/dashboard/settings' and verify the 'Payment Platform Alerts' card reflects the updated recipients with a direct link back to Payment Gateways.
Clear the recipients on '/dashboard/settings', save, then open '/dashboard/payment-gateways'.
Verify a warning says nobody is emailed about payment problems and links to the recipients field on the Settings page. The same warning appears on the refunds, duplicate payments and webhooks pages.
